optimizedDescription.value: Uniform parser port and extensible registry provide format-neutral AST, delta, serialization, outline, and selector metadata.

optimizedContext.value:
# ArtifactParser Port

## Rules
- `ArtifactParser`: `fileExtensions`, `parse(content)`, `apply(ast, delta)`, `serialize(ast)`, `renderSubtree(node)`, `nodeTypes()`, `outline(ast)`, `deltaInstructions()`, `parseDelta(content)`.
- `ArtifactParserRegistry = ReadonlyMap<string, ArtifactParser>`; standard keys `markdown|json|yaml|plaintext`; composition additively merges external formats while preserving built-ins; unknown format fails clearly.
- `parse` returns normalized `ArtifactAST { root }`. `apply` resolves every selector before mutation; missing/ambiguous selector throws `DeltaApplicationError`, preventing partial application; returns AST + warnings.
- `serialize(parse(content))` must reparse to equivalent AST. Markdown preserves unaffected inline intent and source style markers where unambiguous; mixed styles serialize deterministically.
- `renderSubtree` emits native subtree text. `nodeTypes` describes every addressable type with `type`, `identifiedBy`, `description`, and exact `isCollection|isSequence|isSequenceItem|isContainer|isLeaf` flags. Shared delta engine uses flags, never hardcoded type lists.
- `outline` gives navigable addressable summary; compact defaults: markdown `section`, json `property|array-item`, yaml `pair`, plaintext `paragraph`; full detail available at use-case/command layer.
- Root outline selector hints keyed by node type use placeholders only and avoid per-node duplication; omitted unless requested.
- `deltaInstructions()` returns format-static text injected verbatim for delta artifacts.
- `parseDelta` returns typed `DeltaEntry[]`; YAML normally implements, others may return empty. `no-op` mixed with another operation throws `SchemaValidationError`.
- `ArtifactNode`: `type`, optional `label`, scalar `value`, `children`, `level`, `ordered`, adapter metadata. `DeltaEntry.op = added|modified|removed|no-op`; optional selector/position/rename/content/value/strategy/mergeKey; description allowed always and ignored during application.

## Constraints
- Port lives `application/ports/`; no parser-library dependency.
- Domain services reference port only, never concrete parsers.
- `Selector` and `DeltaPosition` are domain value objects.
